name: flashinfer_contest_l1_018_qknorm_rope_kvcache
author: flashinfer
description: Qwen3-Coder fused Q/K RMSNorm + RoPE + KV cache update: FlashInfer rmsnorm per-head, manual rotate_half RoPE, in-place KV cache index assignment.

sources.content:
import torch
import flashinfer.norm as fn


def _rotate_half(x):
    half = x.shape[-1] // 2
    return torch.cat((-x[..., half:], x[..., :half]), dim=-1)


@torch.no_grad()
def run(query, key, value, position_ids, key_cache, value_cache,
        cache_position, q_norm_weight, k_norm_weight, inv_freq, rms_norm_eps):
    b, nq, s, d = query.shape
    nkv = key.shape[1]

    q_normed = fn.rmsnorm(query.reshape(-1, d).contiguous(), q_norm_weight, rms_norm_eps).view(b, nq, s, d)
    k_normed = fn.rmsnorm(key.reshape(-1, d).contiguous(), k_norm_weight, rms_norm_eps).view(b, nkv, s, d)

    inv_e = inv_freq[None, None, :].expand(b, s, -1)
    pos = position_ids[:, :, None].float()
    freqs = pos * inv_e
    emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)
    cos = emb.cos().to(query.dtype).unsqueeze(1)
    sin = emb.sin().to(query.dtype).unsqueeze(1)

    q_rot = q_normed * cos + _rotate_half(q_normed) * sin
    k_rot = k_normed * cos + _rotate_half(k_normed) * sin

    key_cache[:, :, cache_position] = k_rot
    value_cache[:, :, cache_position] = value

    return q_rot, k_rot, key_cache, value_cache
